name: AMERIKANER
description: Amerikaner is a highly popular Norwegian trick-taking game that combines elements of bidding, secret partnerships, and a kitty exchange. Despite its name, the game is uniquely Scandinavian and features a distinct 'trump-on-the-lead' mechanic where the bidder's first card determines the trump suit and their partner simultaneously.

content.text: Amerikaner is a highly popular Norwegian trick-taking game that combines elements of bidding, secret partnerships, and a kitty exchange. Despite its name, the game is uniquely Scandinavian and features a distinct 'trump-on-the-lead' mechanic where the bidder's first card determines the trump suit and their partner simultaneously.

Originating in Norway, the game's name 'Amerikaner' is a mystery to historians, as it bears little resemblance to standard American card games. It belongs to the broader 'Boston' family of bidding games that were fashionable in Northern Europe in the late 19th century.
Each player is dealt 12 cards, one at a time. The remaining 4 cards are placed face down in the center to form the 'Kitty'.

items.text: No-Kitty Variant: All 52 cards are dealt (13 each). The minimum bid is increased to 7.
Joker Variant: Jokers are added. A led Joker wins the trick automatically. If discarded when void, it has no power.
